urls.title: Web page URLs
urls.description: Pages to save as PDF, exactly as Chrome prints them (one PDF per URL).

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: One Markdown document (GitHub flavour: tables, task lists, code). Becomes a clean paper-style PDF.

html.title: HTML
html.description: One full HTML document, CSS included. Remote images and fonts are loaded.

documents.title: Documents (bulk)
documents.description: Many documents at once: [{ "html": "…", "name": "invoice-1042" }, { "markdown": "# Hi" }, { "url": "https://…" }]. The name becomes the file name.

template.title: HTML template
template.description: Mail-merge: one PDF per object in Records. {{field}} is replaced by that record's value (HTML-escaped), {{{field}}} inserts raw HTML, {{customer.name}} reaches nested values.

records.title: Records
records.description: Data for the template, one object per PDF. A fileName (or name / id) field names the file.

landscape.title: Landscape
landscape.description: Turn pages sideways (good for wide tables and dashboards).

pageNumbers.title: Page numbers
pageNumbers.description: Adds "1 / 5" at the bottom of every page.

printBackground.title: Print backgrounds
printBackground.description: Keep background colours and images (off = what a browser prints by default).

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Zoom of the content, 0.1–2 (e.g. 0.8 fits wide pages).

preferCssPageSize.title: Use the page's own @page size
preferCssPageSize.description: If the HTML sets @page { size: … }, use that instead of Paper size.

media.title: CSS media
media.description: print uses the site's print stylesheet; screen makes the PDF look like the page on screen.

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description: When the page counts as loaded. Network idle waits for late images and scripts.

waitMs.title: Extra wait (ms)
waitMs.description: Wait this long after loading, for animations or charts.

hideSelectors.title: Hide elements (CSS selectors)
hideSelectors.description: Cookie banners, chat bubbles, ads… e.g. #cookie-banner, .intercom-launcher

viewportWidth.title: Viewport width (px)
viewportWidth.description: Window width the page is laid out in before printing (affects responsive sites).

locale.title: Browser language
locale.description: Accept-Language sent to web pages (e.g. id-ID), for sites that switch language.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per document (s)
timeoutSecs.description: A document that takes longer fails (and is not charged).

zip.title: Bundle into one ZIP
zip.description: With more than one PDF, also saves pdfs.zip.
